title: test(plugin-list): the inlineFlsNoop UNAUTHORED case waits for the object-schema headers, not the first render
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoKVUc6H29jLDJsTfYRni5MR)_

Fixes #37972

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改了列表页的一个自动化测试，产品行为不变。
- 这个测试在慢的检查机上会偶发失败，挡住了与界面无关的修复合并；修好后这类合并不再被它卡住。
- 出错的话只是这个测试再次偶发失败，删掉本次改动即可撤回，不影响任何用户。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.inlineFlsNoop-6723.test.tsx`, the UNAUTHORED case only.

The rows can paint before the object schema arrives. Until it does, `objectSchema` is null, so `generateColumns()` answers from the row keys on the inline-data path (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx:783-784`): `Id` shown, `Amount` dropped by the #6723 gate. The case took the first non-empty header set, so on a slow runner it read that render and failed with `expected [ 'Id', 'Opportunity Name' ] to not include 'Id'` (PR #37948, jobs 140512339260 and 140529997984).

The case now waits until the headers equal the object-schema set, `['Opportunity Name']`, before it asserts. The three assertions after the wait (`toContain('Opportunity Name')`, `not.toContain('Amount')`, `not.toContain('Id')`) are unchanged. No other case changes; the CONTROL case's `toContain('Amount')` stays as it is. No source file changes. The file is not published (test-only), so `skip-changeset`.

## Tests

All runs from `ui/`: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.inlineFlsNoop-6723.test.tsx`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, on head `db083480` (base `origin/main` 0b539b6a).

| Run | Result |
|:--|:--|
| This head, three runs | 3/3 passed, each time |
| Race forced: `getObjectSchema` delayed 300 ms, OLD case (0b539b6a) | red: `expected [ 'Id', 'Opportunity Name' ] to not include 'Id'` at `:171`, the CI message exactly |
| Race forced: same 300 ms delay, this head | 3/3 passed |
| Ablation: `rowKeysWouldOutrankSchemaPolicy` forced to `false` (grid stays on the inline-data path), this head | red: `expected [ 'Id', 'Opportunity Name' ] to deeply equal [ 'Opportunity Name' ]` at `:165` (the new wait); the other two cases green |

Both mutations went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 -> 0, blob moved, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty). `@object-ui/plugin-grid` resolves to `src` through the `ui/vitest.config.mts` alias, so the ablation needs no build.

## Acceptance notes

- Seen, not fixed here (card #37972 names it out of scope): `StudioRoute.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx` red `Test UI (13/16)` once on PR #37962. Different test, no change.

## Verification

Two-minute check: run the command above from `ui/`; expected `Tests 3 passed (3)`. To see the race the old case lost, delay `getObjectSchema` in the file's `makeDataSource()` by 300 ms: this head stays green.
